name: A Small Encounter
source:
Within the dusty corners of a witch's hut, a small butterfly looking for food stumbles upon an equally hungry spider. But, perhaps, their encounter will satisfy more than merely their appetites! 

[From [url=https://amiableapp.itch.io/a-small-encounter]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在女巫小屋的尘土飞扬的角落里，一只正在寻找食物的小蝴蝶偶然发现了一只同样饥饿的蜘蛛。但也许，他们的相遇不仅仅满足他们的胃口！

[来自[url=https://amiableapp.itch.io/a-small-encounter]itch.io[/url]]
